issue.body:
JobRunr Version
6.0.0

JDK Version
OpenJDK 11.0.15

Your SQL / NoSQL database
Postgres 14

### What happened?
When i add a method parameter of JobContext to a recurring job, similar to your suggestion: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/73745947/how-to-get-job-context-for-recurring-job

During the build step i get (using Quarkus):
`Build step org.jobrunr.quarkus.extension.deployment.JobRunrExtensionProcessor#findRecurringJobAnnotationsAndScheduleThem threw an exception: java.lang.IllegalStateException:` Methods annotated with org.jobrunr.quarkus.annotations.Recurring can only have zero parameters or a single parameter of type JobContext.

I tried doing the same thing with your example quarkus project, but i get a similar error there.

### How to reproduce?

```
  @Recurring(id = "jb", cron = "*/1 * * * *")
  @Job(name = "Job")
  public void recurringJob(JobContext jobContext) {
     System.out.print("Text");
  }
```
